method: Every record is one manually reviewed disagreement between fallow and knip on the pinned conformance corpus. A record is written only after the disagreement was traced to a pipeline layer against source, before any fix lands. Records are keyed on (project, issue_type, path, export_name), the same tuple the per-project report emits in its details rows.

verdicts.fallow_wrong: Source review shows fallow's finding (or missing finding) is incorrect.
verdicts.knip_wrong: Source review shows knip's finding (or missing finding) is incorrect.
verdicts.model_difference: Both tools are defensible; the tools answer different questions for this row.

causes.extract: Parser dispatch or visitor never produced the symbol or reference.
causes.resolve: Specifier or alias resolution pointed at the wrong module.
causes.graph: Edge construction or re-export chaining lost the connection.
causes.reachability: Entry points or traversal decided the wrong reachable set.
causes.analysis: The analyzer applied the wrong rule to a correct graph.
causes.suppression: A suppression marker was honored or ignored incorrectly.
causes.filters: Issue filtering or production mode dropped or kept the wrong row.
causes.report-assembly: The finding was correct but rendered under the wrong path, name, or type.
